query: Why deep sea creatures are surfacing?
title: Why deep sea creatures are surfacing?
description:
Many midwater animals rise naturally toward the surface every night to feed, then descend before daylight. A true deep resident found at the surface is a separate event that requires species, health, current, weather, and collection context.
